issue.title: Fix role permissions
issue.body:
Steps to reproduce:
1. Open a dashboard and click `Edit dashboard`.
2. Drag a markdown component into a new row.

Expected behavior: the component is added and the layout saves.
Actual behavior: the drop is rejected and the console logs `Cannot add component: parent not found`.
Affected code: `superset-frontend/src/dashboard/util/dnd-reorder.ts`.
Acceptance criteria: the markdown component drops into the row and the dashboard DnD tests pass.
